sample_method: Purposive second cohort of 12 reports not included in the initial ten-document formatting pilot, across a proof, candidate architecture, models, SQLite/C interop, experiments and audit summaries; no prevalence estimate
source_binding: All report and one principal referenced-source Git blob hashes verified through GitHub at baseline
verdict_boundary: These are scoped report-to-source trace interpretations, not independent re-runs, proof checking, authoritative acceptance or full-corpus correctness
